goal: Drop an obsolete startup locale hack no longer needed after switching from Boost to std::filesystem
Prevent platform issues on systems like illumos and avoid test failures when locales are not installed
agreement: Strong support across reviewers with no open objections
Initial objection about GUI test failure resolved after adopting reviewer fix commit (stickies-v)
Nonblocking suggestion to add a release note for notify script users (maflcko, stickies-v)

categories.name: utils
why: P3 because it cleans up an obsolete Boost workaround that causes startup issues on platforms like illumos
Low impact because bitcoind does not rely on locale-sensitive filesystem APIs on POSIX
